_: Per-suite end-to-end durations, harvested from ONE real CI run. WHAT THIS IS: the input to the shard assignment in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so that assignment is derived from data rather than from an impression. Consumed only by check:e2e-roster's PRINTED summary. WHAT THIS IS NOT: a budget, a bar, or anything any gate asserts against. No test compares a wall-clock time to a number in this file, and none may: docs/specs/ci-sharding/feature-spec.md 1.4 forbids a wall-clock assertion anywhere in this epic, because five samples of the same job span 40-47 minutes and the slowest measured altered no test at all. These are ratios that happen to carry units. STALENESS: the run id and date below are printed beside every projection, so a reader sees the projection's age at the same time as the projection. They will drift as suites are added and that is expected; re-harvest rather than trusting them. RE-HARVEST 2026-10-13 (pre-1-0-hardening M1): every web figure is the MEDIAN of three runs (38314679272, 38315222823 and 38317448630, the last being `run`), one step per test:e2e script, mapped by the script the step runs; `job` is the longest web job of the last of them (shard 4). The median, not the mean, because run 38317448630's base `test:e2e` took 272 s against ~390 s on the other two. Each shard's FIXED cost (job wall less its suite steps: setup, install, browser install, build, artefact upload) measured 90-174 s over the twelve shard-runs, median 114 s, and it is roughly uniform: there is NO shard-4-specific overhead. Shard 4 was slow because its suite sum was high, so the pack adds the same 114 s to every shard. The two API figures are carried over unchanged from the 2026-10-12 harvest (run 38290423490); this re-harvest read web shard jobs only. This replaces the 2026-10-12 web harvest (run 38290423490). Step timings are whole seconds, and a step includes its own server start, so a suite that builds first (forced-colors, splitting) carries the build here. The runs are samples on shared runners: read them for ratios.
residualCheck: The 50 web durations sum to 3760 s. There is no independently-recorded total to reconcile against this time: each figure is a median of three runs, so no single run's suite steps sum to it. The projected shard sums (suite steps only) are 936 s (shard 1), 936 s (shard 2), 953 s (shard 3) and 935 s (shard 4); with the 114 s median fixed cost, 1,050 / 1,050 / 1,067 / 1,049 s. The check still does what it exists for - a hand-edit cannot pass unnoticed - and this edit is recorded rather than hidden by rounding it into a neighbour.
keyedBy: The package.json SCRIPT NAME, not the CI step's title and not a prose suite label. A title is prose; the script is the key check:e2e-roster derives its own roster from, so the two cannot drift apart.
